preservationRule: all predecessor responsibilities remain required; ABI-v3 relocates none of them to caller data or comparison metadata

v3Responsibilities.statement: The exact P3DM manifest core and ordinal-specific P3RI role instance are selected by each spent P2SH20 source lock, never by a caller-decoded manifest.
DEPOSIT or WITHDRAWAL and all topology/economics labels derive only from the checked state-successor minus state-source value delta.
Every carrier has one lock-selected ordinal, source/successor lock, final redeem, frame, and role-local fixed index.
Only the state mutable-NFT-zero observation or role-derived token-free NONE observation is admitted; the known projection collision is never reclassified.
Every full carrier unlocking bytecode, canonical push, frame, payload, and final redeem is consumed in ordinal order.
Every published ABI-v3 leaf has exactly one allowed source class and every derived leaf declares existing acyclic dependency nodes.
No outer-root, carrier-session, envelope, schedule, or provenance result feeds proof or payload construction.
The structural compiler ends every redeem in OP_FALSE and cannot establish proof, VM, standardness, transaction, deployment, or activation credit.
